name: Shandong Jinjing Science & Technology Stock Co.,Ltd
summary: Shandong Jinjing Science & Technology Stock Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development, production, fabrication, and operation of glass, soda ash, and its derivatives in China and internationally. The company offers float, ultra clear, solar ultra clear, tinted, anti-reflective, and ultra large and ultra thick glass; off-line low-e coating, passive house LOW-e, low-e coated, ultra clear low-e, and industrial low-e glass; anti-reflective glass under the ZHIZHEN brand; and processed glass, including shower door, solar, elevator, patterned curtain wall, furniture, greenhouse, and rail glass.
